name: First-owner bootstrap and organization-scoped session
preconditions: Local API is bound to loopback

steps.action: Verify one-time token digest and create first owner in org-demo
steps.result: Token is consumed; salted password hash is stored; session is issued

steps.action: Verify login and server-side session expiry/user-enabled state
steps.result: Only active organization user receives scoped actor context

steps.action: Scope account/site/job queries and refresh requests to the actor organization
steps.result: Cross-organization references resolve as not found or denied

steps.action: Recheck requester organization, active state, and operator role before queued work
steps.result: Revoked or downgraded actor job fails closed

steps.action: Delete server-side session and expire cookie

resume_path: Retry sign-in with the owner account; if first-run token is lost before setup, restart the local service to regenerate it while no users exist.
rollback_path: Logout or disable the user to revoke sessions. This prototype has no self-service recovery or MFA recovery.
